note: Every enumerated value set that may appear in more than one file, each with the reason. Every entry is vocabulary, which recurs in prose by its nature. A set that is not vocabulary has one home and is cited everywhere else, and a set not listed here fails the build the moment it is written out twice; a set listed here that is no longer written out twice fails it too, so the list only shrinks.

exceptions.reason: The logical operators. Prose about them is not a value set.
Type names. Naming the types is not enumerating an argument.
The bool type and its two literals.
Bar fields. Every page that teaches bars names them.
